content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media operator software and managed operations, not airline or travel distribution systems."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for pay-TV and telecom operators, unlike Sabre's travel booking platforms."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer engagement and knowledge software, with no travel booking or airline distribution business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Business management and payments software for small local service businesses, not travel technology."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Bank and merchant payment processing in Puerto Rico and Latin America, a different transaction business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells in-flight connectivity hardware and internet service to airlines, not booking or distribution software."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Marketing data connectivity and identity software for brands and advertisers, unrelated to travel distribution."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"General application development, data platform and infrastructure software, not travel booking technology."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Vertical merchant payment processing and bill payment for healthcare and government, not travel."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience software for brands, with no travel distribution business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Financial firm software and outsourced fund administration, serving asset managers rather than travel buyers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Consumer travel review and advertising platform monetized from travelers and hotels, not B2B airline distribution."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Fleet fuel cards, corporate payments and health account administration, a different payments business."}]}
